title: MCP 2026-07-28 Release Candidate: The Protocol Goes Stateless
why_it_matters: The next MCP spec drops the handshake and session ID entirely — any request can hit any server instance. Plus first-class extensions (MCP Apps, Tasks), auth hardening, and a formal deprecation policy. This is the biggest protocol-level change since MCP launched.
action: Read the RC spec and plan your migration

title: Microsoft reportedly cancels internal Claude Code licenses over token-based billing costs
why_it_matters: After widely publicized reports of Microsoft engineers choosing Claude Code over Copilot, Microsoft has reportedly pulled internal Claude Code licenses because token-based billing made costs untenable at scale.
